verses.text: Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
lines: Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you.
Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

verses.text: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
lines: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion,
ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

verses.text: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
lines: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this,
if there is iniquity in my hands,

verses.text: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),
lines: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me
(yes, I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),

verses.text: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust.
lines: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it;
yes, let him tread my life down to the earth,
and lay my glory in the dust.

verses.text: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
lines: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger.
Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries.
Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

verses.text: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
lines: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you.
Rule over them on high.

verses.text: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
lines: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples.
Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness,
and to my integrity that is in me.

verses.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
lines: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end,
but establish the righteous;
their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

verses.text: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
lines: My shield is with God,
who saves the upright in heart.

verses.text: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
lines: God is a righteous judge,
yes, a God who has indignation every day.

verses.text: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
lines: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword;
he has bent and strung his bow.

verses.text: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
lines: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death.
He makes ready his flaming arrows.

verses.text: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
lines: Behold, he travails with iniquity.
Yes, he has conceived mischief,
and brought out falsehood.

verses.text: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
lines: He has dug a hole,
and has fallen into the pit which he made.

verses.text: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
lines: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head.
His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

verses.text: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
lines: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness,
and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
